bio_draft: Profound is a hip-hop and electronic producer from Chandigarh, based in New Delhi. His debut EP Returning Rituals came out with KRUNK in 2015 and the beat tape fre$h on Knowmad Records in 2017. He played the first Boxout Weekender in 2018 as a Boxout.fm Recordings artist.

bio_sources.fact: From Chandigarh, based in New Delhi

notes: City: 2015 Wild City says Chandigarh based; 2017 pieces say Delhi based with Chandigarh as hometown. Sources give a legal name (left out per brief). Rolling Stone India also names earlier releases 'Faded' (no year, not added). The 2017 era quote is from Wild City; Rolling Stone India places fre$h in vaporwave and lo-fi hip-hop.

bio_draft: Reggae Rajahs are a reggae sound system of DJs and MCs from New Delhi, formed in 2009 by DJ MoCity, Diggy Dang and Mr Herbalist, who play dub, reggae and dancehall. They ran the weekly show Pressure Drop, later on boxout.fm, started Goa Sunsplash in 2016 and have played Rototom Sunsplash, Sziget and Outlook in Europe.

bio_sources.fact: Sound system of DJs and MCs, New Delhi, 2009, dub reggae dancehall
Founders DJ MoCity, Diggy Dang, Mr Herbalist
Pressure Drop on boxout.fm; Goa Sunsplash 2016

notes: Kind: a sound system crew; 'collective' is the closest option. Our genres (reggae, dub) match. Members per sources: DJ MoCity, Diggy Dang, Mr Herbalist (Zorawar Shukla), DJ Jun (2010), later General Zooz, Ziggy B, BeLights. Started at founding as 'Reggae India' (Caravan), renamed April 2009; not added as an alias since it was the pre-launch party name. Pressure Drop began on Radio79.com in 2013 before boxout.fm. Website reggaerajahs.com only from Wikipedia, not opened. No releases found.
